postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
The number of elements in each sequence is between 3 and 100.
Each element in the sequences a, b, and c is between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: a_i != b_i and a_i != c_i and b_i != c_i for all i
postconditions.description: No two elements in the sequences a, b, and c are equal for any index i.

invariants.expression: p_i in {a_i, b_i, c_i} for all i
invariants.description: Each element in the sequence p is one of the elements from the sequences a, b, or c.

invariants.expression: p_i != p_{(i mod n) + 1} for all i
invariants.description: No two adjacent elements in the sequence p are equal.
